quote.heading: Confirm your project before ordering
quote.body: Contact Dana to confirm the item, quantity and final price. Payment is required before production.

about.intro: Beese & Co. creates personalized gifts, laser engraving and UV printing in Northern Illinois. Dana works with your artwork, name, logo or idea to make something personal.
about.process: For custom orders, you approve a taped proof before production begins. Shop an available product or contact Dana to discuss a group order or a project that needs a quote.

faq.payment: Payment is required before production. Shipping and applicable taxes are shown at checkout.
faq.proof_heading: Will I see my custom design first?
faq.proof: Custom orders receive a taped proof by text for approval before production begins. Provide your mobile number and artwork or personalization details when ordering.
faq.shipping: Pickup is available in Spring Grove, Illinois. Domestic economy shipping is free on orders of $75 or more. Production timing is confirmed with your proof; shipping transit time is additional.

process.step_1_body: Select your product options. For custom orders, provide artwork, text or a saved-artwork reference.
process.step_2_body: Payment is required before production. Shipping and taxes appear at checkout.
process.step_3_body: For custom orders, approve your taped proof by text before we make your item.
process.step_4_body: Choose pickup or shipping at checkout. Custom production timing is confirmed with your proof.

empty.body: Choose a product to start your order.
